run_mae_pretraining: run MAE pre-training on ImageNet with a ViT-L/16 model for 400 epochs using default settings
run_mae_pretraining_custom_model: run MAE pre-training with a custom model name like mae_vit_base_patch16 on a specified dataset path
run_mae_pretraining_distributed: run distributed MAE pre-training across multiple GPUs with configurable world size and batch size
run_mae_pretraining_resume: resume MAE pre-training from a saved checkpoint using the resume flag with a checkpoint path
run_mae_pretraining_config: run MAE pre-training with custom mask ratio, learning rate, warmup epochs, and gradient accumulation settings
